about.title: About me:
about.basic_info_desc: Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience developing software solutions using Python and the .NET ecosystem. I hold both a Bachelor's and a Master's degree in Computer Science, specializing in Software Engineering. I combine software engineering practices with expertise in Machine Learning and Neural Networks. I am seeking opportunities to build scalable software and AI-driven solutions.

tasks: Architecting and implementing core modules for driver monitoring applications using Python and .NET.
Designing, developing, and implementing new software applications to improve company productivity.
Streamlining software deployment processes by configuring GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
Automating data processing workflows, reducing the need for manual work.
Resolving critical production bugs in legacy systems.
Collaborating within a Scrum team, using Git for version control and Jira for task management.

projects.name: Deep Neural Networks in Survival Analysis
projects.description: (Python, PyTorch, PyCox, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, Matplotlib) Developing custom deep neural network models based on existing models and comparing their effectiveness with classical survival analysis methods on 7 large datasets of oncology patients (over 600,000 records).

projects.name: DiagnoseMe
projects.description: (C#, WPF, LLM, OpenAI, API) Integrating the OpenAI API into a C# desktop application to provide AI-assisted initial medical diagnosis and recommendations for further action based on the user's initial description of symptoms.

projects.name: News Extractor (NLP)
projects.description: (Scikit-Learn, spaCy, Pandas, Matplotlib) Extracting event information from news articles (who, what, where, when). Classifying event types into six different categories. Training dataset containing over 2,000 sentences, including the NO_EVENT category.
